judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies every acceptance criterion from the issue: it removes the `instanceof Error` gate on `onError`, wraps non-`Error` rejections in `new Error(String(error), {cause: error})`, leaves the re-thrown rejection untouched, updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (plus line numbers in linked specs), and documents the change in `CHANGELOG.md`. It tests string, plain object, and `undefined` rejections while keeping existing `Error` tests intact. Compared to the reference, the candidate uses `String(error)` directly instead of attempting `JSON.stringify` first via `describeRejection`, and it introduces an extra `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file alongside `.lore/dod.md` rather than keeping all tests inside `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
